IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.single_origin: Blue's view of Red originates only at _side_tensors('blue'), whose enemy_x/enemy_y are red_x/red_y. All derived opponent geometry (relative dx/dy, distances, grid enemy channel) is computed downstream of that dict, so substituting there satisfies the frozen leakage_rule by construction rather than by inspection.
IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.why_not_a_blanket_patch: _side_tensors is ALSO called by gpu_env/_core/_mines.py (2 sites) and _rules.py (1 site). Patching it globally would corrupt mine mechanics and win determination and would violate world_truth_unchanged. The substitution is therefore gated on a flag raised ONLY inside the two observation builders that consume enemy position: _build_grid_obs and _build_vec_obs.
IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.action_mask_verified_unaffected: _build_action_mask was read in full: it uses only own_alive, own_carrying, own_mine_charges, own_x, own_y and pickup positions -- no enemy field. Action legality is provably independent of the intervention.
IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.world_truth_unchanged: red_x/red_y are never written. Red's behaviour tree acts on truth throughout; only Blue's observation is filtered.
IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.t0_rule: the hook is installed AFTER env.reset(), capturing the true initial Red pose. Because the held values ARE the t0 values, Blue's first observation is bit-identical with or without the hook, exactly as the parent spec requires.
IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.no_reacquisition: permanent hold after t0 for the selected indices, per v1
IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ITS_LEAKAGE_GUARANTEE.forbidden_fillers_not_used: held values are the true last-known t0 pose -- never map centre, zeros, or noise
